title: Add optional purchase order delivery date and supplier reference
head: feature/stock-po-delivery-metadata
body:
Purchase-order drafts can now store an optional expected delivery date and supplier reference. The saved metadata appears in the existing scoped order context and supplier print. Old callers that omit the fields preserve existing values; explicit blank values clear them. Date-only formatting avoids timezone shifts, and historical orders remain null rather than receiving inferred dates.

Stacked on #1207. Existing create/update authority, row locks, version checks, draft-only edits, independent approval and price visibility remain. A separate metadata-only UPDATE guard requires actual value changes to stay draft→draft with version +1; original approval/short-close guards are untouched. The nullable additive migration has no backfill, INSERT restriction or grant and a no-op down that preserves history. Coordinator approval under the owner's technical delegation covers exact migration SHA256 `76d874383747b49f34bc94e87a9ca90e63f57ae6899a4236a224e4adb0ac96c7`; this is not attributed to a fresh owner reply. Audit payloads include supplied field names only.

Validation:
- New metadata plus unchanged approval/print/receiving: 40 tests /426 assertions passed. After adding invalid year-zero rejection, the seven metadata tests /73 assertions passed again. Repeated migration up/down/up preserves values and guards; every non-draft state and stale/raw version change is refused.
- Full frontend2260/2260, types, resource formatting, production build, Pint and scoped PHPStan0 passed. Full ESLint found nine owned formatting issues; repaired files then passed scoped lint. No existing assertions changed. Three actual-SFC tests independently exercise payload omission/clear, refused draft retention and genuine context resets.
- Actual synthetic UI: create, edit, competing stale refusal, submit, independent Finance approval, CA print with prices hidden, and explicit clearing. Approved version5 retains3Dec2026/reference; creator/submitter5 differs from approver7. All balances and24 movements remain unchanged; metadata audit leak query returns0.
- Six create and six edit captures at390/768/1440 light/dark show new44/36 controls and no overflow/errors. Print captures show actual date/reference and loaded synthetic logo. Same-identity draft retention is distinguished from stale-version refresh restoring current saved values.

Independent source/design reviews bind the frozen12-file patch `3b1712c867d80aa60cdad04725ea0bce3df8244ce558780e18bea135e7bb957d`; artifacts: `/workspace/kpone-validation/stock-po-metadata/`. Browser harness initially raced unsettled Inertia responses; explicit saved-value/status waits corrected the harness. Two synthetic drafts were used; no duplicate-post/idempotency claim.

No production execution or merge. Pack conversion, inferred lead-time suggestions, aggregate estimates and full PO worklist composition remain separate; this delivers the real optional metadata contract without changing approval policy.
